outdatedRunner.text: The runner {{name}} needs an update before it can connect. Run this on its machine (its pairing and settings are kept):

memory.title: Memory
memory.subtitle: What every agent of the workspace reads when its Jobs start.

overridden.text: It is {{plugin}}'s. An update of the plugin replaces what you haven't changed, and it goes when the plugin is uninstalled.

people.title: People
people.unavailable: People is unavailable in this workspace.
people.effect: {{email}} will lose access to this workspace and its jobs.
people.removeFailed: Could not remove access. Try again.
people.deleteEffect: {{email}} can’t sign in any more and leaves the organization. What they made stays. Their account and data are deleted for good after {{days}} days; until then you can restore them.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.revokeFailed: Could not revoke the invitation. Try again.
invitations.handoff: Verify that you’re speaking to {{email}}, then give them this link directly. Anyone holding it can use it to register a new account if the invitation allows that.
invitations.unavailable: This invitation is no longer pending.
invitations.manual: Select and copy the link above.
invitations.instructions: Invite someone to {{workspaceName}} in {{organizationName}}. A new link replaces any pending invitation for the same address. An organization owner must invite anyone who needs a new account.
invitations.createFailed: Could not create an invitation. Try again.

dataRetention.title: Data retention
dataRetention.text: For the whole organization: how long deleted people and Audit records are kept before they are removed for good.
dataRetention.personBefore: Permanently delete users and their data
dataRetention.range: A whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}

deletedPeople.title: Deleted people
deletedPeople.text: People you deleted from the organization. Each is deleted for good on the date shown; until then you can restore them, with no workspace role.

organizationPeople.title: Organization members
organizationPeople.text: Everyone in the organization, with the workspaces they have a role in. Give someone a role in a workspace or take it away, remove them from the organization, delete their account, or make them its owner.
organizationPeople.loadFailed: Could not load the organization’s members.
organizationPeople.everyWorkspace: Has every right in every workspace.
organizationPeople.noWorkspace: No role in any workspace yet.
organizationPeople.makeOwnerEffect: {{name}} gets every right in every workspace of the organization, and you become a member. Only {{name}} can give you the ownership back.
organizationPeople.makeOwnerKeeps: You keep only your roles in {{workspaces, list}}.
organizationPeople.makeOwnerKeepsNone: You have no role in any workspace, so you lose access to all of them until {{name}} gives you one.
organizationPeople.leaveEffect: {{email}} loses access to every workspace of the organization. Their account and what they made stay. To bring them back, invite them again.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: What to check when something seems wrong in this workspace.
system.managersOnly: Only the workspace’s managers see this page.
system.loadFailed: Could not load the system’s state.
system.stale: Could not refresh: this is what the server answered at {{time}}.

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.stale: Last tick {{age}} ago: schedules and polls aren’t running. Check the server’s logs.
scheduler.none: The scheduler doesn’t run in the server process that answered.

polls.title: Failing polls
polls.none: No poll trigger’s latest poll failed.
polls.count_one: The latest poll of {{count}} poll trigger failed.
polls.count_other: The latest poll of {{count}} poll triggers failed.
